import Mathlib

structure MaxMatchingGraph where
  left_size : Nat
  right_size : Nat
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def MaxMatchingGraph.well_formed (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  g.adj.size = g.left_size ∧
  ∀ u, u < g.left_size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.right_size

def MaxMatchingGraph.has_edge (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.left_size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

-- Matching definition
structure Matching where
  edges : List (Nat × Nat)

def Matching.is_valid (m : Matching) (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ e, e ∈ m.edges → g.has_edge e.1 e.2

def Matching.is_disjoint (m : Matching) : Prop :=
  ∀ e1 e2, e1 ∈ m.edges → e2 ∈ m.edges → e1 ≠ e2 →
    e1.1 ≠ e2.1 ∧ e1.2 ≠ e2.2

def Matching.size (m : Matching) : Nat :=
  m.edges.length

def is_matching (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (m : Matching) : Prop :=
  m.is_valid g ∧ 
  m.is_disjoint ∧
  m.edges.Nodup

def is_max_matching_size (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ m, is_matching g m ∧ m.size = k) ∧
  (∀ m, is_matching g m → m.size ≤ k)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def max_bipartite_matching_precond (graph : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.left_size ≤ 1000 ∧ graph.right_size ≤ 1000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def matchingEdgeUniverse (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Finset (Nat × Nat) :=
  Finset.range g.left_size ×ˢ Finset.range g.right_size

def GoodEdgeSet (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ s, g.has_edge e.1 e.2) ∧
  ∀ e₁ ∈ s, ∀ e₂ ∈ s, e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    e₁.1 ≠ e₂.1 ∧ e₁.2 ≠ e₂.2

instance goodEdgeSetDecidable (g : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (GoodEdgeSet g s) := by
  unfold GoodEdgeSet MaxMatchingGraph.has_edge
  infer_instance

def candidateMatchingSets (g : MaxMatchingGraph) :
    Finset (Finset (Nat × Nat)) :=
  (matchingEdgeUniverse g).powerset.filter
    (fun s => GoodEdgeSet g s)

def candidateMatchingCards (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Finset Nat :=
  (candidateMatchingSets g).image Finset.card

noncomputable def finsetMatching
    (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) : Matching :=
  ⟨s.toList⟩

lemma candidateMatchingCards_nonempty (g : MaxMatchingGraph) :
    (candidateMatchingCards g).Nonempty := by
  classical
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rw [candidateMatchingCards, Finset.mem_image]
  refine ⟨∅, ?_, rfl⟩
  simp [candidateMatchingSets, GoodEdgeSet]
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def max_bipartite_matching (graph : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (h_precond : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (candidateMatchingCards graph).max'
    (candidateMatchingCards_nonempty graph)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def max_bipartite_matching_postcond (graph : MaxMatchingGraph) (result : Nat)
    (_ : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_max_matching_size graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma mem_candidateMatchingSets_iff (g : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) :
    s ∈ candidateMatchingSets g ↔
      s ⊆ matchingEdgeUniverse g ∧ GoodEdgeSet g s := by
  simp [candidateMatchingSets]

lemma finsetMatching_is_matching (g : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) (hgood : GoodEdgeSet g s) :
    is_matching g (finsetMatching s) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    apply hgood.1 e
    simpa [finsetMatching] using he
  · intro e₁ e₂ he₁ he₂ hne
    exact hgood.2 e₁
      (by simpa [finsetMatching] using he₁)
      e₂
      (by simpa [finsetMatching] using he₂)
      hne
  · change s.toList.Nodup
    exact Finset.nodup_toList s

lemma matching_toFinset_mem_candidates
    (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (m : Matching) (hm : is_matching g m) :
    m.edges.toFinset ∈ candidateMatchingSets g := by
  classical
  rw [mem_candidateMatchingSets_iff]
  constructor
  · intro e he
    have hel : e ∈ m.edges := by
      simpa using he
    have hedge : g.has_edge e.1 e.2 :=
      hm.1 e hel
    have hv : e.2 < g.right_size :=
      hwf.2 e.1 hedge.1 e.2 hedge.2
    simp only [matchingEdgeUniverse, Finset.mem_product,
      Finset.mem_range]
    exact ⟨hedge.1, hv⟩
  · constructor
    · intro e he
      apply hm.1 e
      simpa using he
    · intro e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ hne
      exact hm.2.1 e₁ e₂
        (by simpa using he₁)
        (by simpa using he₂)
        hne

lemma card_toFinset_eq_length {l : List (Nat × Nat)}
    (h : l.Nodup) :
    l.toFinset.card = l.length := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons a l ih =>
      simp only [List.nodup_cons] at h
      simp [h.1, ih h.2]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem max_bipartite_matching_postcond_satisfied (graph : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (h_precond : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) :
    max_bipartite_matching_postcond graph
      (max_bipartite_matching graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  classical

  let cards := candidateMatchingCards graph
  have hcards : cards.Nonempty := by
    simpa [cards] using candidateMatchingCards_nonempty graph

  let result := cards.max' hcards

  have hresult_mem : result ∈ cards := by
    exact Finset.max'_mem cards hcards

  have hresult_mem' :
      result ∈ candidateMatchingCards graph := by
    simpa [cards, result] using hresult_mem

  obtain ⟨s, hs_candidate, hs_card⟩ :=
    Finset.mem_image.mp hresult_mem'

  have hs_good : GoodEdgeSet graph s :=
    (mem_candidateMatchingSets_iff graph s).mp hs_candidate |>.2

  change is_max_matching_size graph
    ((candidateMatchingCards graph).max'
      (candidateMatchingCards_nonempty graph))

  constructor
  · refine ⟨finsetMatching s,
      finsetMatching_is_matching graph s hs_good, ?_⟩
    change s.toList.length =
      (candidateMatchingCards graph).max'
        (candidateMatchingCards_nonempty graph)
    rw [Finset.length_toList]
    rw [hs_card]
  · intro m hm
    have hm_candidate :
        m.edges.toFinset ∈ candidateMatchingSets graph :=
      matching_toFinset_mem_candidates graph h_precond.1 m hm

    have hm_card_mem :
        m.edges.toFinset.card ∈ candidateMatchingCards graph := by
      rw [candidateMatchingCards, Finset.mem_image]
      exact ⟨m.edges.toFinset, hm_candidate, rfl⟩

    have hle :
        m.edges.toFinset.card ≤
          (candidateMatchingCards graph).max'
            (candidateMatchingCards_nonempty graph) :=
      Finset.le_max'
        (candidateMatchingCards graph)
        m.edges.toFinset.card
        hm_card_mem

    have hcard :
        m.edges.toFinset.card = m.edges.length :=
      card_toFinset_eq_length hm.2.2

    change m.edges.length ≤
      (candidateMatchingCards graph).max'
        (candidateMatchingCards_nonempty graph)
    rw [← hcard]
    exact hle
  -- !benchmark @end proof

  right_size : Nat
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def MaxMatchingGraph.has_edge (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.left_size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

  edges : List (Nat × Nat)

def Matching.is_valid (m : Matching) (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ e, e ∈ m.edges → g.has_edge e.1 e.2

  ∀ e1 e2, e1 ∈ m.edges → e2 ∈ m.edges → e1 ≠ e2 →
    e1.1 ≠ e2.1 ∧ e1.2 ≠ e2.2

def Matching.size (m : Matching) : Nat :=
  m.edges.length

def is_matching (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (m : Matching) : Prop :=
  m.is_valid g ∧ 
  m.is_disjoint ∧
  m.edges.Nodup

def is_max_matching_size (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ m, is_matching g m ∧ m.size = k) ∧
  (∀ m, is_matching g m → m.size ≤ k)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def max_bipartite_matching_precond (graph : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.left_size ≤ 1000 ∧ graph.right_size ≤ 1000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def matchingEdgeUniverse (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Finset (Nat × Nat) :=
  Finset.range g.left_size ×ˢ Finset.range g.right_size

def GoodEdgeSet (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ s, g.has_edge e.1 e.2) ∧
  ∀ e₁ ∈ s, ∀ e₂ ∈ s, e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    e₁.1 ≠ e₂.1 ∧ e₁.2 ≠ e₂.2

def matchingSetCheck (g : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) : Bool :=
  (s.all fun e => decide (g.has_edge e.1 e.2)) &&
  (s.all fun e₁ =>
    s.all fun e₂ =>
      decide
        (e₁ = e₂ ∨
          (e₁.1 ≠ e₂.1 ∧ e₁.2 ≠ e₂.2)))

def candidateMatchingSets (g : MaxMatchingGraph) :
    Finset (Finset (Nat × Nat)) :=
  (matchingEdgeUniverse g).powerset.filter
    (fun s => matchingSetCheck g s = true)

def maxMatchingCardinality : List (Finset (Nat × Nat)) → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | s :: ss => max s.card (maxMatchingCardinality ss)

def finsetMatching (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) : Matching :=
  ⟨s.toList⟩
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def max_bipartite_matching (graph : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (h_precond : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  maxMatchingCardinality (candidateMatchingSets graph).toList
  -- !benchmark @end code

def max_bipartite_matching_postcond (graph : MaxMatchingGraph) (result : Nat)
    (_ : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) : Prop :=

  is_max_matching_size graph result

    decide_eq_true_eq]

  · rintro ⟨hvalid, hdisjoint⟩
    refine ⟨hvalid, ?_⟩
    intro e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ hne
    exact (hdisjoint e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂).resolve_left hne
  · rintro ⟨hvalid, hdisjoint⟩
    refine ⟨hvalid, ?_⟩
    intro e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂
    by_cases h : e₁ = e₂
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (hdisjoint e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ h)

lemma mem_candidateMatchingSets_iff (g : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (s : Finset (Nat × Nat)) :
    s ∈ candidateMatchingSets g ↔
      s ⊆ matchingEdgeUniverse g ∧ GoodEdgeSet g s := by
  simp [candidateMatchingSets, matchingSetCheck_iff]

    s.card ≤ maxMatchingCardinality ss := by
  induction ss with
  | nil =>
      simp at h
  | cons a ss ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
      simp only [maxMatchingCardinality]
      rcases h with rfl | h
      · exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
      · exact le_trans (ih h) (Nat.le_max_right _ _)

    (ss : List (Finset (Nat × Nat))) (hss : ss ≠ []) :
    ∃ s, s ∈ ss ∧ s.card = maxMatchingCardinality ss := by
  induction ss with
  | nil =>
      exact False.elim (hss rfl)
  | cons a ss ih =>
      simp only [maxMatchingCardinality]
      by_cases hs : ss = []
      · subst ss
        exact ⟨a, by simp, by simp⟩
      · obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_card⟩ := ih hs
        by_cases hle : a.card ≤ maxMatchingCardinality ss
        · refine ⟨s, by simp [hs_mem], ?_⟩
          rw [Nat.max_eq_right hle]
          exact hs_card
        · have hge : maxMatchingCardinality ss ≤ a.card := by omega
          refine ⟨a, by simp, ?_⟩
          rw [Nat.max_eq_left hge]

    l.toFinset.card = l.length := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons a l ih =>
      simp only [List.nodup_cons] at h
      simp [h.1, ih h.2]

    is_matching g (finsetMatching s) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, by simp [finsetMatching]⟩
  · intro e he
    apply hgood.1 e
    simpa [finsetMatching] using he
  · intro e₁ e₂ he₁ he₂ hne
    apply hgood.2 e₁
    · simpa [finsetMatching] using he₁
    · apply e₂
    · simpa [finsetMatching] using he₂
    · exact hne

lemma matching_toFinset_mem_candidates
    (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (m : Matching) (hm : is_matching g m) :
    m.edges.toFinset ∈ candidateMatchingSets g := by
  rw [mem_candidateMatchingSets_iff]

  · intro e he
    have hel : e ∈ m.edges := by
      simpa using he
    have hedge := hm.1 e hel
    have hv : e.2 < g.right_size :=
      hwf.2 e.1 hedge.1 e.2 hedge.2
    simp [matchingEdgeUniverse, hedge.1, hv]
  · constructor
    · intro e he
      apply hm.1 e
      simpa using he
    · intro e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ hne
      apply hm.2.1 e₁ e₂
      · simpa using he₁
      · simpa using he₂
      · exact hne

lemma empty_mem_candidateMatchingSets (g : MaxMatchingGraph) :
    (∅ : Finset (Nat × Nat)) ∈ candidateMatchingSets g := by
  rw [mem_candidateMatchingSets_iff]
  constructor
  · exact Finset.empty_subset _
  · simp [GoodEdgeSet]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem max_bipartite_matching_postcond_satisfied (graph : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (h_precond : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) :
    max_bipartite_matching_postcond graph
      (max_bipartite_matching graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  change is_max_matching_size graph
    (maxMatchingCardinality (candidateMatchingSets graph).toList)

  have hempty :
      (∅ : Finset (Nat × Nat)) ∈ candidateMatchingSets graph :=
    empty_mem_candidateMatchingSets graph

  have hnonempty : (candidateMatchingSets graph).toList ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    have hmem :
        (∅ : Finset (Nat × Nat)) ∈
          (candidateMatchingSets graph).toList := by
      simpa using hempty
    simp [h] at hmem

  obtain ⟨s, hs_list, hs_card⟩ :=
    maxMatchingCardinality_exists
      (candidateMatchingSets graph).toList hnonempty

  have hs_candidate : s ∈ candidateMatchingSets graph := by
    simpa using hs_list

  have hs_good : GoodEdgeSet graph s :=
    (mem_candidateMatchingSets_iff graph s).mp hs_candidate |>.2

  constructor
  · refine ⟨finsetMatching s,
      finsetMatching_is_matching graph s hs_good, ?_⟩
    simpa [Matching.size, finsetMatching] using hs_card
  · intro m hm
    have hm_candidate :
        m.edges.toFinset ∈ candidateMatchingSets graph :=
      matching_toFinset_mem_candidates graph h_precond.1 m hm

    have hm_list :
        m.edges.toFinset ∈ (candidateMatchingSets graph).toList := by
      simpa using hm_candidate

    have hle :
        m.edges.toFinset.card ≤
          maxMatchingCardinality (candidateMatchingSets graph).toList :=
      le_maxMatchingCardinality_of_mem
        m.edges.toFinset (candidateMatchingSets graph).toList hm_list

    have hcard :
        m.edges.toFinset.card = m.edges.length :=
